steps: Under your strategy, the hundred-man unit collapses and Angie surrenders. Alone with you, she reveals the truth: she too reached the future and saw ruin. With the last bullet, she turns it on herself...
Lady Angie, we need to fall back. Our attacks are barely scratching this Stellaroid...
I don't think so. From the combat logs from the Waterway, we just need to break that magic array on its head.
This Stellaroid is nothing like that one... We've tried, and it's not working.
Our magic can't even pierce its magical barrier. This isn't just some normal Stellaroid... It's an Archon!
No! I have to kill the Tyrant here and now. ==SEX1== has become the true Tyrant.
If magic won't cut it, let's see how it handles the Scepter of Death.
Angie's bullet tears through the Stellaroid's magical barrier, embedding itself in the magic array on its head.
The Imperial Guard will fulfill its duty... We'll cover your escape...
By the time Noya and I climb out of the Wishing Box, the floor is already littered with unconscious Committee members.
The only person left standing in the room ... is Angie.
Boss, the Soul Stone retrieval team is back.
Amber, keep an eye on her. Noya and I will bring the others up.
As the rest of our team trickles into the Boss's Domain, Angie doesn't so much as flinch. She just stands there frozen.
It's over, Angie. All three Committee companies have been routed inside the Monolith.==W== Greyhorn, No. 160, and Gunhild are all in our custody.
Heh. You're right. I have lost.
You're incredible.==W== Even with all the memories of the future... I still couldn't defeat you.
Memories? What is she talking about?
==PLAYER_NAME==, don't waste your breath on her.
And this will all be over.
This knave has repeatedly plotted against you. Say the word, my ==SEX11==, and I shall strike her down.
If you surrender, we won't hurt you. I can guarantee you a fair trial.
Even now, you still intend to spare my life.
You'd better not mistake that for a weakness, Angie.
I just want to give you a fair end. Don't think for a second I won't kill you.
I know. That's exactly why I'm considering your offer.
Look at the chips you hold. You're in no position to negotiate right now.
Heh. I believe you will agree to this condition, Tyrant.
I want to speak with you alone. Right here is fine, just ask your companions to keep their distance.
What could we have left to talk about?
I want to tell you the truth about the end of the world. And it's for your ears only.
What's the point? Even if I agree, I'm just going to tell them everything once we're done.
Some truths only bring more trouble if they reach the wrong ears.
You'll understand once you hear it.
During my last two negotiations with Angie, she brought up a lot of things... Things I had no idea about.
The late Empress's diary, the falling Monolith, and the "trump card" she never revealed... Even if it's just for the intel, it's worth hearing what she has to say.
Iris, Nazuka. Cast some defensive magic on my clothes.
Alright. Everyone's backed up to the edge of the room. They won't be able to hear us from here.
Now, talk. What is this truth about the end of the world?
Thank you for agreeing to my terms. You even left me with the Scepter of Death… After everything you've done, I must return the favor sincerely.
I am from the future. Four years from now.
This is by no means a joke. Four years from now, this world will end.
The world will shatter into ruins, civilizations will collapse, and not even ashes will remain of the Nova Empire.
Everything you and I love...==W== Everything you and I hate... They will all be wiped out.
And the root of it all ... is the Tyrant.==W== Which means me.
You're the Tyrant? What are you talking about?!
By a stroke of fate, I once obtained a cellphone. It looked exactly like the one in your hand.
The Well of Worlds Tyrant Development System. Does that sound familiar?
I had nothing back then. For my own sake, and for my companions, I fought tooth and nail to complete that system's missions. Over and over again, it handed me rewards I couldn't even fathom.
Eventually, I completed every single mission. I fulfilled every single wish.
But it all ended with the Monolith collapsing right in front of me... Along with this world.
I used the rewards the system gave me to make one final wish. I escaped ten years into the past... That would be six years in the past from now.
However, even though I ran from reality, I never had the courage to open that safe again. Nor the courage to face my future allies.
All I could do was desperately gather information and watch that Soul Shop from afar.
And... During this time, the new Tyrant was chosen… And it was none other than you.
Ahahahahaha!! That's it! That's the look, Tyrant.
You must know about that system too. Hehe... Why can I assert that? It's simple.==W== What you are doing is the same as what I did in the past.
You realize I'm not lying, don't you? Something so beyond human understanding ... can't possibly stem from pure imagination, can it?
Your actions happen to align with the Book of Grace Prophecies, but I wouldn't have acted on that alone.
The late Empress kept an old book hidden with your portrait drawn, but I wouldn't have acted on that alone either.
That's because... After having gone back to the past, I no longer believe in anyone ... or anything.
However... I have no choice but to believe in myself.
The Tyrant who destroys the world is the Tyrant who possesses that system!
==Off==I have only ever had one goal. And that is to save Nova from a Tyrant like that.
Do you understand what I'm trying to tell you? Tyrant... If you weren't here, the disaster ahead of us wouldn't come to pass.
Having said that, I'm aware of how unreasonable I sound right now...
Dying with you would be my atonement.
What nonsense are you daydreaming about? Why would I throw my life away over your insane ramblings?!
Our deaths alone will pave the way to everyone's salvation! Therefore, I will sacrifice everything for Nova!
Well, Tyrant, what do you say?
It's not only for the people of Mirage! You'll also be protecting the very people you care about!
That's enough bluffing from you. My fate is mine to decide.
If there really is a crisis capable of destroying the world, I would fight to stop it no matter what!
You're trying to use my friends and Mirage as leverage, but you've already fired nine rounds from that Scepter of Death. You only have one bullet left, don't you?
Heh. So you were counting after all.
It is as you say. The Scepter of Death has only one charge left... It can't even penetrate your magic protection.
Will you die with me, or will all of Nova be buried with us?
... Have these repeated defeats finally driven you out of your mind?
No matter what I do, I can never get ahead of you.
You saw through every move I make. Even when I thought I had caught up, I was still a step too late.
How can that be when I am the one with memories of the future? Hah, it's so frustrating...
But, judging by that look of confusion, you still don't know ... about my secret weapon.
Angie slowly pulls out a chess piece... A Black Rook.
You have a Seal of Grace too...
This Black Rook grants me the authority to control a Monolith.
Except this Monolith is very unusual and suspends itself high up in the sky.==W== Only the person holding this piece can travel there using a special cape.
A Monolith in the sky?! You mean—
Right now, that Monolith is hovering above Mirage, so high up it's invisible to the naked eye.
By the way, if my breathing stops, this Monolith will start to crumble … and collapse from the sky. Then—
That's right! Everything will be buried in the darkness of history! So will Mirage and everything that happened there!
Possibly. But if it takes an insane person to save the world—
I will gladly take on that role.
Wait, Angie! Put down the Scepter of Death!
By sacrificing only a worthless small town on the border, the rest of the world shall escape annihilation.
Since you're running a company, you should know whether the payoff justifies the cost.
—and become the foundation of the new world.
The Boss and those people in the Grace Imperium uniforms should be fighting inside this Monolith...
I absolutely won't miss this time.
Monoliths are Nocturn Eterna's home turf!
Huh? Why did the sky go dark? Wh-What is that?! Why is there a Monolith in the sky?!
